text:
Researcher | Pollen | Ecology | Environmental Science
Welcome to my academic website!
I am a researcher interested in pollen, climate change, and paleoecology.


I am interested in understanding the relationships between climate, and environmental changes through pollen analysis and related paleoecological approaches.

title: Publications
text:
My research publications focus on palynology, paleoecology, vegetation history, Holocene environmental change, and human impacts on ecosystems in East and Southeast Asia.
For a complete and updated publication list, please visit my Google Scholar profile.
